quotes.text: D211683 removed registration for old text, vCard, and Mork file importers and removed dead text/vCard sources from moz.build. The prior address book test consolidation had moved coverage to AddrBookFileImporter, the path used by about:import. The MorkImport.cpp source still appeared in this intermediate build file, so distinguish removal of the import contract from removal of every Mork-related source. For new file import work, inspect the current live importer before reusing old contract IDs.
